collection.description: While repairing an old roof, a villager finds their favorite childhood toy tucked deep in the thatch.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: While repairing an old roof, (subject) finds something tucked deep in the thatch: a little carved fish, worn smooth, with one fin missing. (subject.He/She) knows it instantly. It was (subject.his/her) favorite toy, years and years ago, and (subject.he/she) has no idea how it got up there.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) puts the little fish in (subject.his/her) pocket and finishes the roof. That evening (subject.he/she) sets it on a shelf and looks at it for a while. It doesn't do anything. It just sits there being small and old and familiar, and somehow that's enough.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: (subject) takes the fish down and hands it to (friend), a small child who has been watching the repairs. "This was mine, a long time ago," (subject.he/she) says. "It needs someone to play with it." (friend) studies it seriously, then runs off making swimming noises. (subject) feels oddly light.
